Corpus Systems Engineering

SEBoK Systems Engineering Process, Distilled

Fifth-batch SEBoK distillation, batch 2/5 doc 7 (SE-174). The named Systems Engineering Process page is editorially absent (404 against the prompt-named URL); the discipline carries on the Process Concepts page (SE-044, Cluster I canonical anchor per §VII.6 D7), which is itself an index page that distributes process content to Process Description and Process Concurrency, Iteration, and Recursion. The 404 + index-only-carrier is a fresh D8 sub-pattern: index-only carrier — the discipline's main page is an index that references sub-pages without itself supplying the formalization. Distinct from internal-migration (SE-138) which migrates content into surrounding pages and from external-migration (SE-139) which migrates outside SEBoK; index-only-carrier is a third migration mode where the formalization rung is split between an index and its sub-pages. Per §VII.7's matured D8 four-mode taxonomy (bidirectional-fold, internal-migration, external-migration, dual-discipline-distribution), the index-only-carrier is a fifth candidate mode. The structural read otherwise reaffirms Cluster I (concurrency-iteration-recursion as SE-044 anchor formulation) at maximum strength, with ISO/IEC/IEEE 24774 as the standards-body keeper-binding (Cluster B with-central-integrator at process-description rung). Four clusters compose; D8 fifth migration mode is candidate.

II. Source Read

Both Systems Engineering Process and Applying the Systems Engineering Process return 404. Process Concepts page supplies: "Systems engineering relies on a well-defined set of processes that guide the development of complex systems along the whole life cycle." Processes "are not meant to be executed in a serial, sequential fashion." Three execution mechanisms: Concurrency (processes operating simultaneously), Iteration (repeated cycles of process execution), Recursion (processes applied at multiple organizational levels). Standards binding: "ISO/IEC/IEEE 24774 standardizes process descriptions to ensure clarity, consistency, and comparability." Page structure: index referencing two sub-articles — Process Description and Process Concurrency, Iteration, and Recursion. Page itself "functions primarily as an index and introduction to these topics, with the actual detailed content residing in the linked articles."

III. Structural Read

Cluster J D8 (dispersed-instrument), index-only-carrier sub-mode candidate. Two 404s + one index-only carrier signal a fresh D8 sub-pattern. §VII.7's matured four-mode taxonomy (bidirectional-fold, internal-migration, external-migration, dual-discipline-distribution) does not cover the case where the discipline's main carrier is itself an index that distributes content to sub-pages without supplying the formalization at the index rung. Index-only-carrier is a candidate fifth D8 mode: the formalization migrates one rung down into sub-articles while preserving the parent name as an index. Distinct from internal-migration (which migrates across pages at the same rung) and from dual-discipline-distribution (which splits across two distinct disciplines). New refinement candidate.

Cluster I (pin-art / temporal-concurrency, SE-044 SEBoK-side anchor) at maximum strength. §VII.6 D7 names SE-044 (Process Concepts) as Cluster I's canonical SEBoK-side anchor article. SE-174 reads through SE-044 directly: the concurrency-iteration-recursion triplet is the anchor formulation reproduced as the page's primary structural content. Cluster I anchor binding is reaffirmed at maximum strength.

Cluster A three-axis temporal-execution lattice. Concurrency × Iteration × Recursion is a three-axis universal-sibling lattice at the process-execution rung. Each axis binds process execution aspect-wise: every SE process runs concurrently with others, iterates, and recurses across organizational levels. Convergent with SE-044's Appendix C reading; SE-174 reads it at the parent index rung.

Cluster B with-central-integrator at standards-body rung. ISO/IEC/IEEE 24774 as the standards-body that "standardizes process descriptions to ensure clarity, consistency, and comparability" reads as Cluster B with-central-integrator at the standards-body rung: ISO/IEC/IEEE is the central integrator, the various practitioner communities (INCOSE, NASA, defense primes, software engineering bodies) are sibling keepers around it. Convergent with §VII.7 three-scale formalization-strong; SE-174 supplies a standards-body-rung instance.

Cluster K (virtue constraints) at procedure-binding rung. "Well-defined set of processes that guide the development" reads as V3-as-procedure-binding at the SE-process rung: the procedures bind because virtue is structurally insufficient to guide complex-system development across the whole life cycle. Convergent with §VII.7 V3 saturation (13 instances + cost-binding/constraint-throughout-binding candidates); SE-174 is the 15th-or-later instance.

Cluster I anchor confirmation strengthens D7 discipline. §VII.6 D7 (anchor-article-per-cluster) records SE-044 as Cluster I's anchor. SE-174's reading confirms: even when the named discipline page is absent, the index carrier (SE-044) carries the Cluster I formalization. The D7 anchor discipline is robust against editorial absence at the discipline-name rung.
